findings.text: Condition inverted: default packages install when EXIT_CODE is non-zero (error) instead of zero (success). With a successful 'nvm use', EXIT_CODE stays 0/unset and packages are skipped; with a failed 'nvm use', packages incorrectly install.
Condition inverted: reinstall-packages runs when EXIT_CODE is non-zero (error) instead of zero (success). Failed 'nvm use' or 'install-latest-npm' triggers unwanted package reinstallation.
Condition inverted: alias is set only when EXIT_CODE is non-zero (error). Successful installs skip alias creation; failed installs incorrectly create aliases.

EXIT_CODE declared without initialization before the 'already installed' branch. If nvm use succeeds without entering install-latest-npm, EXIT_CODE is empty/unset, causing '[ $EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ]' to fail or behave unpredictably.

0.reason: The finding identifies the same inverted condition on EXIT_CODE in the already-installed branch that gates default-packages installation on failure instead of success, which is the reference bug.

1.reason: The finding identifies the same inverted condition on EXIT_CODE in the already-installed branch that gates reinstall-packages on failure instead of success, which is the reference bug.
